items.title: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills — 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents · Mapped to 6 frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE
items.one_liner: An Apache 2.0 project provides 817 agent-ready cybersecurity skills mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND, and NIST frameworks.
items.summary: An open-source repository titled Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills has been updated with 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents. The dataset maps across six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE F3 across 29 security domains. It supports integration with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and over 20 other platforms under an Apache 2.0 license.
key_facts: Frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND, NIST AI RMF, MITRE F3
items.bottom_line: AI agent builders can integrate 817 standardized cybersecurity skill definitions directly into Claude Code, Copilot, or CLI tooling.

claims.text: The repository includes 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to 6 frameworks.
claims.support_span: 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents · Mapped to 6 frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND, NIST AI RMF & MITRE F3 (Fight Fraud) · agentskills.io standard · Works with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI & 20+ platforms · 29 security domains · Apache 2.0 GitHub repository mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills, 32,179 stars, language Python.
